description: Weekly pricing conversation coach for Solum Health sales calls. Pulls calls from Fireflies, extracts all pricing moments, scores each conversation against proven benchmarks, and delivers a coaching report with what worked, what didn't, and specific improvement recommendations. Use this skill when the user says "pricing coach", "pricing feedback", "review my pricing", "how did pricing go this week", "pricing report", "score my calls", "pricing review", "weekly pricing", "sales coaching", or any variation of wanting feedback on how pricing conversations went. Also trigger when the user asks to "run the pricing coach" or "check my pricing this week". Default period: last 7 days. User can specify a different date range.
